about: Dom's picks from the Mixamo library (2026-10-26) for the hero's strikes. Each row is one clip baked into src/assets/warrior.glb beside V1's own (scripts/hero-clips/build.py: the Mixamo clip `mixamo` cut from `from` to `to` seconds, retargeted onto the hero rig the way V1's clips were, `mirror` = the right-handed mirror). The hero's actor plays `clip` in place of V1's clip for `role` (src/fight/characters.ts setHeroClips), easing it so the clip's contact key (`contact`, seconds into the Mixamo clip: the blade at full forward extension, measured) meets V1's contact tick. V1's timing rows (move-defs.json windup/active/recovery/chamber/charges) are untouched. The sim's blade sweeps for `paths` are re-baked from these clips (scripts/hero-clips/bake-blades.mjs -> src/fight/blade-picks.ts); `sweeps` says which sweeps the sim uses under these clips. ?clips=v1 = V1's clips and sweeps exactly.

sweeps.about: Which blade sweeps the sim hits with under the picked clips (Strategy 2026-10-26: reach is a combat number, not a look). "v1" = V1's own sweeps (src/fight/blade-paths.ts), so V1's reach and hits; "clip" = the sweeps re-baked from the picked clips (src/fight/blade-picks.ts: cuts and heavy about 1.35-1.4 m forward at contact, stab about 1.57 m, against about 1.1 m). The page's `?reach=` overrides `default` (src/hero-clips.ts); ?clips=v1 is always V1's sweeps. The drawn blade and its trail follow the clip in both cases (src/fight/characters.ts). Under "v1" each clip's `pullback` (metres) eases the hero's drawn body back along his facing, to the full amount on the contact tick, so the drawn blade tip at contact sits where V1's sweep puts it (Strategy 2026-10-26: a blade drawn past the hit reach reads as a broken hit). It is the picked sweep's tip minus V1's sweep's tip, forward, at the contact tick of the row's paths (test/hero-clips.test.mjs pins it). Presentation only: the sim never reads it; under "clip" it is 0.

blade.about: The striking segment the sweeps are baked along: metres along the node's local Y (V1 scripts/blade-manifest.json, longsword on warrior.glb).

clips.name: Stable Sword Outward Slash
clips.about: The right cut: the blade starts on the hero's right and crosses to his left (measured: tip x -0.93 m at 0.83 s to +1.11 m at 0.97 s), the side move-defs.json light_right comes from.

clips.name: Stable Sword Outward Slash, mirrored
clips.about: The left cut: the same slash mirrored so the blade starts on the hero's left and crosses to his right, still in the right hand: the whole body mirrored, the trunk turned (at most 60 degrees from the hips) and the sword arm laid by IK onto the mirror image's sword hand (build.py backhand). Every cut keeps its shoulders within 60 degrees of its hips (build.py MAX_TWIST; V1's clips stay within 62).

clips.name: Stabbing
clips.about: The stab (move thrust; V1 played the Riposte slash for it). A chained thrust plays it too (src/fight/scene.ts). Mixamo's is a knife stab: held as it comes, the sword stood straight up at the strike, so `aim` turns the wrist once (a constant offset, build.py aim_blade) so the blade points forward at the contact key.

clips.name: Gladius Right Overhead Slash
clips.about: The heavy: a 1.0 s Gladio and Glory clip played on V1's heavy timing (32 + 5 + 31 ticks, chamber 10, charges). Cut from 0.27 s, where the sword is already raised high behind the head, so the chamber tick (and a held, charging heavy) parks on the raised sword; the wind-up then plays 0.2 s of clip over 22 ticks and the downstroke lands on tick 32.
